capabilities.business_reason: Every decision, order, position and PnL fact must trace to immutable strategy identity.
capabilities.dependency: strategy family, definition, version and instance configs
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: ResolvedStrategyConfiguration is deterministic and hashed for every enabled instance.
capabilities.acceptance_test: strategy identity and configuration validation tests
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Additional strategy families can reuse identity chain.

capabilities.business_reason: TFIS must enter market open with prepared plans instead of discovering rules after open.
capabilities.dependency: strategy resolution, monthly status, contract selection compatibility, entry, risk
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: PreMarketStrategyPlan, OpeningMarketContext and EffectiveExecutionPlan exist for supported S23 paths.
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Other products can add product-specific pre-market plan builders.

capabilities.business_reason: A trading system must safely manage existing positions before allowing new entries.
capabilities.dependency: reconciliation snapshot, lifecycle context, EOD decision rules
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: Target-first, ORPT Original-SL, RC revised FSL/TRP and 15:00 carry/square-off paths are deterministic offline.
capabilities.failure_risk: Unprotected carried position or duplicate fresh entry
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Put-side and non-S23 lifecycle rules can add source-backed policies.

capabilities.business_reason: Market and clock events must drive business paths reproducibly.
capabilities.dependency: normalized runtime events, subscription index, instrument state owners
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: Fresh-entry and carried-position streams run from normalized events with deterministic replay/resume.
capabilities.failure_risk: Non-deterministic event ordering or unrelated strategy wakeups
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Captured/replay and live feed adapters can emit the same event contract.

capabilities.business_reason: Before paper authority, runtime must be proven against recorded market streams.
capabilities.dependency: M15 event contract and captured market data
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: One captured/replay session drives the M15 coordinator in shadow-only mode.
capabilities.failure_risk: Synthetic-only evidence hides runtime feed gaps
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Same adapter shape can later support live feed normalization.

capabilities.business_reason: TFIS must know broker truth before deciding fresh entry or carried-position action.
capabilities.dependency: broker orders, fills, positions, local state, persisted events
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: Startup, periodic, post-fill, restart and EOD reconciliation classify all required states.
capabilities.failure_risk: Local state acts against unknown broker truth
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Additional broker adapters can provide truth snapshots.

capabilities.business_reason: Business decisions must stop at a broker-agnostic intent before risk and account authorization.
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: ExecutionIntent contains source, strategy, account, position cycle, contract, side, quantity, purpose, idempotency key and evidence hash.
capabilities.acceptance_test: execution intent contract and idempotency tests
capabilities.failure_risk: Broker order created directly from business artifact
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Live and paper adapters consume the same intent.

capabilities.business_reason: Execution must be blocked by stale data, unresolved rules, reconciliation gaps or kill switches.
capabilities.dependency: execution intent, account state, reconciliation, market freshness
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: Global/account kill switches, max quantity, active order/position limits, stale-data and unresolved-reconciliation blocks are enforced.
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Advanced portfolio controls can attach after V1 facts exist.

capabilities.business_reason: Multiple logical accounts need independent health, order registry, position registry and kill switch.
capabilities.dependency: broker account config, reconciliation, risk limits, execution intents
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: One account block does not corrupt other accounts; credentials do not enter domain events.
capabilities.failure_risk: Cross-account leakage or global unnecessary outage
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Additional brokers/accounts can add coordinator instances.

capabilities.business_reason: Every broker or paper order must have one deterministic owner and legal state transitions.
capabilities.dependency: execution intent, account coordinator, broker-neutral order events
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: Duplicate order/cancel/replace, stale replace, fill after cancel and out-of-order broker events fail closed or reconcile.
capabilities.acceptance_test: order state transition and idempotency tests

capabilities.business_reason: Fills must create and update logical trades with protection and lifecycle invariants.
capabilities.dependency: fills, order state, lifecycle requirements, reconciliation
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: Remaining quantity cannot be negative; active exit quantity cannot exceed confirmed open quantity; closed cycles reject protection.
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Partial exits and advanced trailing logic attach per source rule.

capabilities.business_reason: Paper authority cannot be safe if state is lost across restart.
capabilities.dependency: events, facts, projections, idempotency keys, configuration versions
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: Restart loads config/state, queries broker truth, reconciles, rebuilds coordinators and blocks inconsistent streams.
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Event/fact tables can feed richer analytics later.

capabilities.business_reason: Version 1 must measure realized/unrealized P&L and strategy performance from broker-confirmed facts.
capabilities.dependency: fills, charges, position cycles, trade facts
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: TradeFact and PnLFact support daily, strategy, account, broker and instrument P&L queries.
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Advanced analytics can reuse immutable facts.

capabilities.business_reason: Paper authority should begin with one fully certified strategy before portfolio expansion.
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: One S23 Call-side strategy completes paper gate with no broker/live authority.
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Additional strategies use the same authority gate.

capabilities.business_reason: Live money requires separate broker truth, operator approval, kill switch and reconciliation evidence.
capabilities.dependency: paper acceptance, broker event ingress, live reconciliation, operator approval
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: Live-money readiness review explicitly enables one controlled account/strategy route.
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Multiple live accounts can be added only after controlled rollout.

capabilities.business_reason: These are not needed for a safe first end-to-end trading system.
capabilities.acceptance_criterion: Deferred; V1 preserves facts and identities needed later.
capabilities.deferred_extension_point: Immutable decision/order/trade/PnL facts keep this possible.
